approvers: Project manager, managing director, main contractor or architect on spec
reason: We spend about 8,500 a year on glazing damage, paid from contingency. At 19 per m2 on a 1,000 m2 year I would pay 19,000 to prevent 8,500 of damage, which makes no sense. Deposits up front are also not how we pay.
objection: It costs more than twice what the damage costs us. I would also worry about adhesion and residue on coated glass and powder-coated frames, and about marking the frames when it is peeled off.
instead: Keep doing nothing, use cheap tape and film on the worst spots, and clean or replace at snagging from contingency.
would_change_my_mind: A price near 5 per m2 on terms of 60 days or more, plus written compatibility proof on coated glass and a test panel on our own frames at no charge.
